content: Sameela Xeegetethaa
Na7ay Sameeli Eelipe garsara Godaas oothees; Godaa qaalay he wode daro al7o; qoncethika baawa.
Ayfey daaburin waayetidi xeelliya Eeli issi qamma ba bessan zin7is.
He wode Xoossa xompey buroo to7ibeenna; Godaa Taabotey de7iya keethan Sameeli dhiskis.
Goday Sameela xeegis; Sameeli, “Yee” gidi koyis.
I Eeliko woxi bidi, “Neeni xeegin Heko yas” yaagis. Shin Eeli, “Ta nena xeegabike; bada zin7a” yaagin, Sameeli bidi zin7is.
Qassi Goday, “Sameela” yaagidi nam7antho xeegin, Sameeli dendidi, Eeliko bidi, “Neeni xeegin Heko yas” yaagis. Shin Eeli, “Ta na7aw, ta nena xeegabike; bada zin7a” yaagis.
Godaa qaalay buroo iyaw qonciboonna gisho, Sameeli Godaa gideysa eribeenna.
Goday Sameela heedzantho xeegin dendidi, Eeliko bidi, “Neeni xeegin Heko yas” yaagis. Hessan Goday na7aa xeegidaysa Eeli akeekidi,
“Bada zin7a; I nena xeegiyaba gidiko, ‘Godaw, oda; ta ne aylley si7ayis’ yaaga” gidi, Eeli iyaw odin, Sameeli ba bessaa bidi zin7is.
Hessafe guye, Goday yidi iya matan eqidi, kaseysada, “Sameela, Sameela” yaagidi xeegis. Sameeli, “Ne aylley si7ees, oda” yaagis.
Goday Sameela, “Heko, taani asa haythas iitiya issiba Isra7eele bolla oothana hanayis.
He gallas taani Eeli soo asaa bolla oothana gada odida ubbaa koyrope wursethi gakanaw polana.
Eeli eridi seeronna aggida iya nayta nagaraa gisho, taani iya soo asaa bolla merinaw pirdanaysa iyaw kase oda wothas.
Hessa gisho, ‘Eeli soo asaa nagaray yarshoninne imon polo atto geetetenna’ yaagada taani iya soo asaas kase caaqas” yaagis.
Sameeli wontana gakanaw dhiskis; wontin dendidi, Xoossa keetha pengiya dooyis. Sameeli qoncidaba Eelis odanaw yayyis.
Eeli, “Ta na7aw, Sameela” yaagidi xeegis. Sameeli, “Yee” gidi koyis.
Eeli, “Goday new odiday aybee? Taape aykoka qosopa; neeni Xoossay new odidabaape issibaaka taape qosiko, Xoossi nena pirdo” yaagidi oychis.
Sameeli aykoka qosonna ubbaa Eelis odis. Eeli, “I Godaa; bana lo77idaba ootho” yaagis.
Sameeli diccishe bis; Goday iyara de7ees. Sameeli odidabaape issi qaalika sa7an wodhenna.
Daanepe Barsaabe gakanaw, Sameeli tuma Godaa nabe gideysa Isra7eele asa ubbay eris.
Goday Seelon qoncees; yan ba qaalan banatetha Sameelas qoncisees.
